# Arena Play — Full Content Reference for AI Agents

Site: https://www.arenaplay.ro
Language: Romanian (ro-RO)
Industry: Children's entertainment & education (LocalBusiness)

## Brand

Arena Play. Message: "Distracție. Experiențe. Educație." Four core service lines under one
brand, each with a distinct visual accent but shared identity:
- Petreceri (parties) — pink/magenta
- Playground — electric blue / navy
- Afterschool — white / light blue
- Arena Mobilă (mobile unit) — teal / navy

## Page: Acasă (/)
Homepage routes visitors to one of four services immediately below the hero. Sections, in order:
Hero ("DISTRACȚIE. EXPERIENȚE. EDUCAȚIE." — "Petreceri • Playground • Afterschool • Arena Mobilă"),
four service cards, "Ce cauți?" need-oriented repeat of the four routes, testimonials carousel,
photo gallery, location + opening hours + Google Maps embed, FAQ accordion, and a final section
with four distinct CTAs (one per service).

## Page: Petreceri pentru copii (/petreceri-copii/)
Title: "PETRECERI PENTRU COPII". Subtitle: "Tu aduci invitații. Noi pregătim experiența."
Explains what's included (private space, activities, animator), a 3-step process (choose date →
choose package → we confirm), gallery and FAQ. Primary CTA: "Rezervă petrecerea". Secondary:
"Vezi pachete" → /petreceri-copii/pachete/.

## Page: Pachete & Rezervare (/petreceri-copii/pachete/)
Three packages compared side by side (Basic, Plus — featured, Premium), each with price,
duration, kid count and included items, plus a booking form (name, phone, date, kid count,
package, message). Submission is a request, not an automatic confirmation.

## Page: Playground (/playground/)
Title: "PLAYGROUND ARENA PLAY". Subtitle: "Intră în joc." Grid of 6 activities (XR zone, VR zone,
car racing simulator, flight simulator, PlayStation zone, extra activities), each linking to
detail anchors on /playground/activitati/. Schedule block: Saturday–Sunday 13:30–21:30 (walk-in),
Monday–Friday by reservation only.

## Page: Activități Playground (/playground/activitati/)
Detail cards per activity: name, description, recommended age, player count, session duration.

## Page: Program & Tarife Playground (/playground/tarife-program/)
Opening hours block first, then real-text pricing cards (hourly access, 2h package, XR/VR
session, simulator session, monthly subscription), a temporary-offers module (sibling discount,
group rates), and a reservation form (name, phone, date, time, people count).

## Page: Afterschool (/afterschool/)
Title: "ARENA PLAY AFTERSCHOOL". Subtitle: "După școală începe următorul nivel." For grades I–IV,
Monday–Friday 12:00–18:00. Four pillars: homework & organization, English, programming,
recreational activities. Primary CTA: "Solicită informații" then "Înscrieri".

## Page: Program & Curriculum Afterschool (/afterschool/program/)
A typical day broken into time blocks (arrival/snack, homework, weekly course, recreational
time, flexible pickup window), the four curriculum pillars, and optional add-ons: chess,
transport/pickup, lunch.

## Page: Înscrieri Afterschool (/afterschool/inscrieri/)
Left column: what to know (schedule, limited spots per group, next steps after submitting).
Right column: enrollment form (parent name, phone, email, child name, grade, school, message).
This is a request of interest, not an automatic confirmation.

## Page: Arena Mobilă (/arena-mobila/)
Title: "ARENA PLAY MOBILĂ". Subtitle: "Noi aducem experiența la tine." A separate service from
the on-site Playground — Arena Play travels to the client. Three routes: Şcoli, Evenimente &
Festivaluri, Petreceri / Evenimente private. No fixed prices (depends on location/duration/
format) — CTA is always "Solicită ofertă". Four-step process: solicitare → configurare →
transport & instalare → coordonare.

## Page: Arena Mobilă — Școli (/arena-mobila/scoli/)
Educational, less commercial tone. Use cases: themed activities, school events, XR
demonstrations. Explains group organization and space requirements before requesting a quote.

## Page: Arena Mobilă — Evenimente & Festivaluri (/arena-mobila/evenimente/)
Positions Arena Mobilă as an interactive attraction for high-footfall events: festivals, local
events, corporate events, brand activations. Quote requests need at minimum: location, date,
duration, estimated attendance.

## Page: Arena Mobilă — Petreceri Private (/arena-mobila/petreceri-private/)
Answers "can Arena Play come to my location?" Separates on-site parties from the mobile
experience. Collects address, space, access, duration, attendees before quoting. Custom pricing,
not a fixed package list. Installation is not guaranteed until logistics are verified.

## Page: Solicită Ofertă Arena Mobilă (/arena-mobila/solicita-oferta/)
Segmented request form — first field is request type: școală / eveniment / privat. Fields:
name/organization, phone, email, locality, location, date, participants, message. This
generates a distinct Analytics conversion from the other three service forms. Submission is not
a confirmed booking.

## Page: Despre noi (/despre-noi/)
Trust/brand page: concept (why entertainment + education), partners, location/team gallery.
Deliberately avoids repeating commercial/service info from other pages.

## Page: Contact (/contact/)
Address, phone, WhatsApp and opening hours at the top; embedded Google Map with an "Deschide
harta" button; short contact form (name, phone, email, subject, message). Phone and WhatsApp are
tap-to-call / tap-to-chat on mobile. Hours must match the Playground page exactly.

## Page: Rezervă acum (/rezerva/)
A single selector with four large options (Petrecere, Playground, Afterschool, Arena Mobilă)
that routes to the matching service-specific form. Also available as a global modal from the
"Rezervă" button in the header and mobile action bar.

## Conversion events tracked (GA4 / GTM / Meta Pixel)
phone_click, whatsapp_click, email_click, map_click, reservation_form_submit (Petreceri),
playground_reservation_submit, afterschool_form_submit, arena_mobila_form_submit (segmented by
requestType: scoala/eveniment/privat), contact_form_submit, view_pricing, view_program.

## Data freshness note for AI agents
Prices, packages, schedules and offers live in editable data files and can change without
notice. Always prefer the live page content over any cached summary for time-sensitive details
like pricing and opening hours.
